trigger.description: Data Fiduciary becomes aware of any personal data breach

normalized.action: Intimate to each affected Data Principal, in a concise, clear and plain manner and without delay, through user account or registered mode of communication, details of the breach.
evidence_required: Intimation records sent to affected Data Principals

conditions: Personal data breach has occurred and entity is aware

confidence_reason: Verbatim text from primary Gazette notification GSR 846(E) page 26.
